planets.name: HAT-P-33 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HAT-P-33 with a 3.47-day year, found in 2011.

text.card: HAT-P-33 b was found in 2011 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HAT-P-33. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2011, disc_facility HATNet, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.47447703, pl_radj 1.85, pl_bmassj 0.92

quotes.title: HAT-P-33b
quotes.card: HAT-P-33b is a planet in the orbit of HAT-P-33, which lies 1,310 light-years away from Earth.
quotes.introduction: Its discovery was reported in June 2011, although it was suspected to be a planet as early as 2004.

thermal.source: Deming et al. 2023, dayside brightness temperature at 3.6 µm (uniform reanalysis of Spitzer's eclipses, CDS J/AJ/165/104 table 2)
thermal.chosen: 2 measured of 2 rows; the smallest relative uncertainty, then the longest wavelength
